Deltaic Alluvial.name: Deltaic Alluvial Soil
Deltaic Alluvial.description: Highly fertile soil formed by river deposits in delta regions, particularly along the Mahanadi, Brahmani, and Baitarani river deltas.
characteristics: Rich in nutrients due to river sediment deposits

price_influence.reason: Superior fertility and water retention lead to higher yields and better quality crops, commanding premium prices

Deltaic Alluvial.management: Requires proper drainage management during monsoon. Ideal for intensive agriculture.

Coastal Saline.name: Coastal Saline Soil
Coastal Saline.description: Salt-affected soils found in coastal areas, influenced by seawater intrusion and tidal activity.

price_influence.reason: High salinity reduces crop yield and quality. Requires expensive soil amendments and salt-tolerant varieties, lowering market value

Coastal Saline.management: Needs gypsum application, organic matter addition, and proper drainage. Growing salt-tolerant crops recommended.

Black.name: Black Cotton Soil (Vertisols)
Black.description: Deep, dark-colored clay soils with high moisture retention, excellent for cotton and pulses.
characteristics: Swells when wet, cracks when dry

price_influence.reason: Excellent nutrient retention and moisture holding capacity result in consistent yields and superior crop quality, especially for cotton and pulses

Black.management: Requires careful water management. Best suited for rainfed crops. Avoid over-irrigation.

Red.name: Red Lateritic Soil
Red.description: Weathered soil rich in iron and aluminum oxides, common in upland and plateau regions.
characteristics: High iron oxide content (gives red color)

price_influence.reason: Moderate fertility requires balanced fertilization. With proper management, yields are good but not exceptional, resulting in average market prices

Red.management: Needs regular organic matter addition and balanced fertilization. Mulching recommended to prevent erosion.

Laterite.name: Laterite Soil
Laterite.description: Highly weathered tropical soil with hardpan formation, common in high rainfall areas.
characteristics: Forms hard laterite crust when exposed

price_influence.reason: Low fertility and acidic pH reduce crop yields. Requires extensive soil amendments and lime application, increasing production costs and lowering profitability

Laterite.management: Lime application essential. Grow acid-tolerant crops. Add organic matter regularly. Prevent hardpan formation.

Mixed Red and Yellow.name: Mixed Red and Yellow Soil
Mixed Red and Yellow.description: Transitional soil type combining characteristics of red and yellow soils, found in undulating terrain.
characteristics: Better fertility than pure red soil

price_influence.reason: Balanced nutrient profile and good physical properties support healthy crop growth. Moderate input costs with good yields result in favorable market returns

Mixed Red and Yellow.management: Balanced fertilization recommended. Crop rotation beneficial. Maintain organic matter levels.

Mixed Red and Black.name: Mixed Red and Black Soil
Mixed Red and Black.description: Soil with combined properties of red and black soils, offering advantages of both types.
characteristics: Combines moisture retention of black soil
Better drainage than pure black soil
Suitable for both kharif and rabi crops

price_influence.reason: High nutrient content and excellent moisture retention enable superior crop quality and yields. Versatility for multiple crops enhances market value

Mixed Red and Black.management: Maintain soil structure through organic matter. Balanced NPK application. Suitable for intensive cropping.

Brown Forest.name: Brown Forest Soil
Brown Forest.description: Soil developed under forest cover in hilly and mountainous regions with moderate to high rainfall.
characteristics: High organic matter from forest litter

price_influence.reason: Good organic content supports healthy crops. Suitable for high-value spices and vegetables. Moderate yields with quality produce fetch reasonable prices

Brown Forest.management: Prevent soil erosion through terracing. Maintain forest cover. Add lime if too acidic. Suitable for organic farming.
